Edges are taken verbatim from Plan §Cross-Phase Dependencies (the ASCII diagram is the authoritative source); supplemented with the dispatch-prompt's two explicit sequencing constraints (T2.4 ← T2.1 for the OP-7-before-first-emission ordering; T5.3 ← T5.2 and T5.4 ← T5.2 for the post-merge observation chain). They are surfaced per-task via verifies_with_pv pointing at the specific PV-N.Cn criteria each task contributes to. KB-task-decomposition's 'validator-setup' task pattern is folded into the host T-N task because each criterion's automation hook is either (a) a file the task itself produces, or (b) a shell one-liner the task description already specifies.

ac_coverage_summary.coverage_strategy: Per Plan §Acceptance Test Cross-Reference, every Blueprint AC maps to >= 1 Plan task. Acceptance Tests v1.0.1 Coverage Matrix (AT-001..AT-079; AT-080 added in cross-artifact reconciliation per audit cycle 2) maps each AT-NNN to its satisfying Plan task. Test-implementation work is folded into the L2 verification step of the producing task per Plan's L1/L2/L3 discipline (not split into separate test tasks).

pv_coverage_summary.coverage_strategy: Each PV-N.Cn pass criterion maps to one or more tasks via the verifies_with_pv field. Validators themselves are operational gates run by the orchestrator at phase boundaries (per phase-validators.md §Validator metadata), not work-units in this DAG. Validator-setup work is folded into each host task because each criterion's automation hook is either (a) a file the task itself produces, or (b) a shell one-liner specified in the task description.

open_items_for_orchestrator: T2.4 is the single L-sized task in the Plan (FR-4b calibration script: ~150 lines bash, full AC-CS-4b-1..7 coverage). Plan §Estimation Methodology calls it 'at the upper bound of what a single task should carry' and explicitly defers any split decision to implementation time ('if implementation reveals it's larger, split into Signal 1 + Signal 3 only and negative-assertion + event emission + cleanup sub-tasks'). The orchestrator should hand T2.4 to the executor as a single unit; if mid-execution the executor flags scope growth beyond the L envelope, re-decompose into T2.4a (Signal 1 + Signal 3) and T2.4b (negative-assertion + event emission + cleanup) and rewrite the edge from T2.4 → T2.5 as T2.4a → T2.4b → T2.5.

PV-3.C3 (actionlint over both workflow files) has a known soft-fallback: if the actionlint binary is absent in the runtime environment, the validator falls back to mcp__actionlint-mcp__lint_workflow.
